نرعوي (form IX)
# نَرْعَوِي (narʕawī) /nar.ʕa.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْعَوَى (irʕawā)
# نَرْعَوِيَ (narʕawiya) /nar.ʕa.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْعَوَى (irʕawā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
